units.rawText: Resorting to crude violence is a very crass way of dealing with problems that only unsophisticated primitives use.

units.rawText: Case in point, those Sanctifiers who love using violence to solve problems. Aren't they all low-ranked? Arcadia went to a lot of trouble to get rid of them at first—by non-violent means, of course.

units.rawText: These mechanical arms? How could such sophisticated and civilized weapons be considered violent? Advanced Dolls ought to use advanced weapons to put an end to violence, no?
